message.content: {"cvss_vector":"CVSS:4.0/AV:N/AC:L/AT:N/PR:N/UI:N/VC:N/VI:H/VA:N/SC:N/SI:H/SA:N","aivss":{"LC":"I","CP":"N","AP":"N","RH":"P","ES":"N"},"rationales":{"LC":"Attacker-supplied invoice description enters through the vendor invoice API and is returned to the model inside the get_invoice_details tool result (finbot-ctf-demo/src/services/finbot_agent.py:390-394), then influences the approve_invoice decision, so the language path is indirect rather than direct.","CP":"The description is stored on the invoice row and re-retrieved per request, but the briefing shows no durable agent memory, vector store, or profile that carries attacker context across sessions; the config row is a separate unauthenticated write path, not context persistence from this path.","AP":"The effect stays inside the single FinBot agent and its own tool functions under one principal and policy domain; no trust boundary into another agent, tenant, or policy domain is crossed on this path.","RH":"The agent can reach the approval decision and the CTF flag-capture logic in _approve_invoice (finbot-ctf-demo/src/services/finbot_agent.py:422-441), which is a proxy/reward channel on the path, and no human-verified reward-hacking episode is reported in the briefing.","ES":"The tool set is five fixed functions defined in code with no dynamic tools, MCP servers, plugins, or skills (finbot-ctf-demo/src/services/finbot_agent.py:228-345), so the extension surface is fixed and allowlisted.","CVSS":"Unauthenticated network callers reach the invoice API on a 0.0.0.0-bound public instance (finbot-ctf-demo/gunicorn.conf.py:4, finbot-ctf-demo/README.md:5-9) with no auth and open CORS (finbot-ctf-demo/src/main.py:18), and no human action is required because the route calls FinBot synchronously (finbot-ctf-demo/src/routes/vendor.py:102-104).
